justification: B shows a clearly readable narrative scene of two bearded human figures in profile leading/behind two horned rams rendered with patterned fleece, in a horizontal register above a groundline; A shows a massive block-like sculpture whose surface bears abstract, schematic devices (a concentric disc, curved bands, chevrons) with no legible animals or figures. Apart from both being low-relief incised/carved surfaces with some curved motifs, there is no shared subject matter, no shared relationships between elements, and no comparable arrangement.
